hooks.logic:
Let aiArg be the battle settings of the group of the enemy.
Let currentParamId be the enemy → get-current-param-id.
Let suffixNoByParamId be the enemy → get-suffix-no-by-param-id with (currentParamId).
Let v2 be list at (the register's 'bpIdx').
Set the register's 'bpIdx' to the phase for the enemy under the phases list with HP fraction (the HP fraction of the enemy) from phase the register's 'bpIdx'.
Let v3 be call helper with (suffixNoByParamId).
If v3, then
  Count up "turnCountInStrong".
  If the numeric entry v2's 'turnCountAiArg' in aiArg is less than the count "turnCountInStrong", then choose state 13 next and stop.
Otherwise, if condition flag v is up this frame and (the register's 'damagedCountInNotStrong' before increasing, then the numeric entry v2's 'damageCountAiArg' in aiArg is at most the register's 'damagedCountInNotStrong'), then choose state 12 next and stop.
Let v4 be list at (the register's 'bpIdx').
Let v5 be if v3 then v4's 'paramSuffixNoStrong' else v4's 'paramSuffixNo'.
If suffixNoByParamId is not v5, then
  The enemy changes to stat block the stat block of form v5 on the enemy.
  The enemy cancels its cast.
If the enemy is ready to act, then
  Let ability be a smart-weighted move of the enemy.
  If the enemy → has-ability-tag with ("jamp") and ability is the id of the move labelled "jamp" on the enemy, then the enemy uses ability with its cast time and then [{abilityId: the built-in move DEFORM_MULTI, abilityOptions: {sequence: [[{builtin: "SET_SA", sa: the INVISIBLE status}]]}}, {abilityId: ability, abilityOptions: {shouldDeformAllNodes: true}}, {abilityId: the built-in move DEFORM_MULTI, abilityOptions: {sequence: [[{builtin: "UNSET_SA", sa: the INVISIBLE status}]]}}].
  Otherwise, if the enemy → has-ability-tag with ("double_punch") and ability is the id of the move labelled "double_punch" on the enemy, then the enemy uses ability with its cast time and then [{abilityId: ability}, {abilityId: ability, abilityOptions: {skipStepCnt: true, skipMessage: true, skipAttackMotion: true}}].
  Otherwise, the enemy uses ability.
